Jane Smith
Senior Frontend Engineer | San Francisco, CA

Executive Summary:
Frontend Engineer with 5+ years of experience architecting large-scale React web applications, modern TypeScript design systems, and high-performance Web APIs.

Technical Skills:
- Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), Next.js, Redux Toolkit, Zustand
- Styling & UI: Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, Styled Components, Framer Motion
- Tooling & Testing: Vite, Webpack, Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Vitest
- APIs & Protocols: GraphQL, RESTful APIs, WebSockets, OAuth2

Work Experience:
Senior Frontend Developer | WebScale Inc (2022 - Present)
- Led frontend migration of monolithic dashboard to React 18 + Vite micro-frontends, improving Core Web Vitals score by 35 points.
- Created shared component library using Tailwind CSS and TypeScript adopted across 8 product squads.
- Implemented virtualized list rendering and Web Worker caching for data-intensive real-time analytics tables.
